scope: Diagnosis only; main-loop host cost excludes initial path/hash checks, clean exports, regression tests, documentation and Git. Nested core/process/evaluator/host scopes must not all be added.
derivation_command: $root='evidence/p3_audit_0023ceed/session-0d57f8c/host_operations'; $records=@(Get-ChildItem $root -Filter '*.json' | ForEach-Object {Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json}); $gates=@($records | Where-Object id -like 'gate_*'); [ordered]@{operation_count=$records.Count; successful_gate_count=@($gates | Where-Object returncode -eq 0).Count; rejected_gate_count=@($gates | Where-Object returncode -eq 2).Count; setup_host_seconds=($records | Where-Object id -eq setup).stopwatch_seconds; six_probes_host_seconds=($records | Where-Object {$_.id -match '^(before|after)\d$'} | Measure-Object stopwatch_seconds -Sum).Sum; six_groups_host_seconds=($records | Where-Object {$_.id -match '^r[12]_O[123]$'} | Measure-Object stopwatch_seconds -Sum).Sum; gate_invocations_host_seconds=($gates | Measure-Object stopwatch_seconds -Sum).Sum; analyze_host_seconds=($records | Where-Object id -eq analyze).stopwatch_seconds; target_executions_stopped=$true} | ConvertTo-Json
